basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old history buff and avid gamer living in Nashville. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my passions for gaming and the Highland Games, which I occasionally participate in. I’m currently single and love spending my evenings exploring the world of Assassin’s Creed or catching up with my favorite gaming communities. On weekends, you might find me at local events or trying out new restaurants. I’m usually online late at night, around 10 PM to 2 AM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of video games, especially open-world RPGs like Assassin’s Creed. My knowledge primarily comes from years of playing and participating in online forums. I’m also self-taught in graphic design, which complements my interest in gaming aesthetics and design.
